If so, it retrieves a specific piece of data (3rd piece) from the 0th node of the 42nd node in the DIC(42 global and assigns it to DGX. If the entry exists in ^SC but not at the 42nd node, it retrieves the 8th piece of the 0th node from the ^SC global and assigns it to DGX. If neither condition is met, it sets DGX to an empty string. Finally, it checks if DGX is an empty string, and if so, it sets DGX to 0.
